summary:
The proposed system collects real-time data such as rainfall intensity, river water level, soil moisture and weather conditions using sensors and weather data sources. The collected information is processed using an AI-based prediction model to estimate the possibility of flooding. When the water level or predicted flood risk exceeds a predefined safety limit, the system automatically generates early warnings through mobile notifications, SMS or alarms.
The system can also display flood-risk zones on a digital map, helping authorities identify vulnerable locations and plan evacuation activities. This allows residents and disaster management teams to take preventive measures before the flood occurs.
The main objective of FloodGuard is to reduce flood-related damage, protect human lives and improve disaster preparedness through intelligent prediction and timely warnings.
details: Unlike ordinary flood alarms that warn people after water reaches a particular level, FloodGuard aims to predict flood risks by analysing multiple environmental conditions. It can also use NASA satellite rainfall and soil-moisture data to improve flood-risk assessment. 6. Real-Life Application For example, during heavy monsoon rainfall in Kerala, FloodGuard monitors the rainfall and river water levels. If the AI system identifies a high possibility of flooding in a particular area, it sends warnings to nearby residents so they can prepare and follow safety instructions. 7. Main Objective To develop an intelligent, affordable and reliable flood prediction system that provides early warnings, helps disaster management and protects people and infrastructure from flood damage. In one sentence: FloodGuard is a smart system that predicts possible floods using AI and environmental data and warns people before the situation becomes dangerous.
